format: Perl script with embedded ARM assembly
description: This file contains a Perl script that generates ARM assembly code for SHA256 hashing optimized for ARMv4, NEON, and ARMv8 architectures. It includes platform-specific optimizations, assembly routines, and code paths for different ARM architectures, with licensing and copyright information from OpenSSL and CRYPTOGAMS.

methods.name: BODY_00_15
methods.description: Generates assembly code for SHA256 rounds 0-15 for ARM architecture.

methods.name: BODY_16_XX
methods.description: Generates assembly code for SHA256 rounds 16 and beyond for ARM architecture.

methods.name: Xupdate
methods.description: Perl subroutine to generate assembly code for SHA256 rounds with platform-specific optimizations.

methods.name: Xpreload
methods.description: Preloads data into registers for SHA256 processing to optimize performance.

methods.name: unsha256
methods.description: Converts assembly instruction mnemonics into encoded .inst directives for ARMv7.
